Last week, I used an app <u>ⓐto get</u> a backpack. <u>ⓑThe app allows users easily buy and sell secondhand items.</u> Sometimes, people also give (A) ______ items that ______. I saw a post about a nice backpack. Someone was giving it (A) ______. <u>ⓓ그것은 새것만큼 좋아 보였습니다.</u> So, I sent a message to the person who posted it.

User 1: Sure.
Jimin: Great! How can I get it?
User 1: Can you come (B) ______ Central Park at 3:00 p.m. tomorrow?
Jimin: Sure! I'll see you <u>ⓔthen</u>. Thank you!

The next day, I got (A)[ready / tired] to go to the park. I decided to borrow a bike (B)[because of / instead of] taking a bus. My city has <u>ⓐa bike-sharing system</u>. Anyone who has an app can borrow a bike easily. First, you choose a bike <u>ⓑthat</u> you want to use. (①) Then you scan the QR code on the bike. <u>ⓒ이것은 자전거의 자물쇠가 열리게 만듭니다.</u> (②)
Before I rode to the park, I checked the bike carefully. (③) Sometimes, the bikes are not in good condition. (④) When I got there, I returned the bike to a station in the park. (⑤) Using the bike was really (C)[difficult / easy]. Also, I was happy ⓓ______.
